==Quotes==
Why, hello there, and welcome to Ravenshire!

This storied town is one of the oldest in Gilneas, and has long pledged fealty to the lords of Ravenwood Keep.

Since the castle fell under dark times, Lord Ravenwood has relocated his court here, which means that history is being made right before our eyes!

If you'd like to learn more of our fascinating past, I have quite the collection of texts that range from historical accounts and scholarly dissertations, to thrilling folktales and fables.
